The '''Kaasban Sea''' was a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The shanty town of [[Iepatap Harbor]] was built inside a tiny cove on the sea's northern shore.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kaasban Sea was introduced in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="LoNH" />
